title: Highest temperature in London on August 15?
description:
This market will resolve based on the highest temperature recorded in the 'Daily Observations' table on Weather Underground, not the figure displayed in the 'Day High & Low' summary section; in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Daily Observations table shall be the primary resolution source not the Day High & Low section.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the London City Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 15 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the London City Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/gb/london/EGLC.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

Ensemble spreads remain tight around 26–28°C, with limited upside potential absent unexpected warm-air advection or model convergence shifts before resolution. Trader positioning reflects this narrow range, favoring 27°C as the mode while assigning meaningful probability to 26°C if overnight cooling lingers into the daytime. Updated model runs and official Turkish Meteorological Service guidance over the next 24 hours represent the key catalysts that could refine these market-implied odds.

eventMetadata.context_description: Traders assign the highest probabilities to 80–83°F highs for Chicago on August 15 because National Weather Service guidance and ensemble models show substantial uncertainty in afternoon cloud cover, timing of showers, and convective development that would limit daytime heating. A broad unsettled pattern following the August 11 derecho continues to favor southeasterly flow and 60–80% precipitation chances, which historically cap temperatures 3–5°F below clear-sky maxima near the seasonal normal of 82.8°F. Recent model runs diverge on the extent of breaks in cloudiness, keeping the 84–85°F bin at only 11.5% implied probability while lower bins capture the risk of persistent overcast or earlier rain. Updated NWS briefings and afternoon model cycles through August 14 evening remain the key near-term catalysts.

This market will resolve based on the highest temperature recorded in the 'Daily Observations' table on Weather Underground, not the figure displayed in the 'Day High & Low' summary section; in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Daily Observations table shall be the primary resolution source not the Day High & Low section.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 15 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/cn/zhengzhou/ZHCC.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Forecast models from agencies including the BBC and timeanddate.com indicate a daily maximum near 30–32°C in Zhengzhou on August 15 amid scattered clouds, light northeasterly winds, and possible early thundershowers that could cap solar heating. This aligns with historical August baselines of roughly 30–31°C highs and supports the market’s clustering of implied probability around 30–32°C or higher. Variables such as afternoon clearing, reduced precipitation, or model revisions on cloud persistence remain key factors that could shift the verified peak across thresholds before official verification.
